For the petitioner(s) : Mr. Saurabh Shekhar, Advocate For the CBI : Mr. Deepak Kumar Bharti,
Advocate -----
02/09.05.2025: Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned counsel for the CBI.

2. This is an application filed by the petitioner praying for grant of anticipatory bail in terms of sections 482 and 484 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, as the petitioner has been allegedly implicated in connection with FIR being FIR No. RC 05(A)/2012-AHD-R, registered for the offences punishable under sections 420/ 423 /424 /467 /468 /469 /471 /477- A/120B /109 /201 of the Indian Penal Code and under sections 13(2) r/w 13(1)(d) of the Prevention of Corruption Act,
arising out of Vigilance PS Case No. 10 of 2011, pending in the court of learned Additional Judicial Commissioner-XVIII cum Spl. Judge, CBI, Ranchi.
3.

entities.text: Additional Judicial Commissioner-XVIII cum Spl. Judge, CBI, Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The allegation against the petitioner is that she has obtained undue favour in the JPSC examination.
4. It is admitted case of both the parties that now the charge sheet has already been submitted against the petitioner.
It is also admitted by the learned counsel for the CBI that during the period of investigation it was never felt to take the petitioner in custody.
5. Since during investigation the petitioner was not felt to be taken into custody by the CBI, no useful purpose will be served rejecting the present anticipatory bail petition of the petitioner.

sentences.text: 6. Considering the aforesaid facts, I am inclined to release the petitioner on anticipatory bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, above named, is directed to surrender before the court below within four weeks from today and 2025:JHHC:14035 in the event of her surrender/arrest the learned court below is directed to enlarge her on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (rupees ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Judicial Commissioner-XVIII cum Spl. Judge, CBI, Ranchi, in connection with FIR being FIR No.
RC 05(A)/2012-AHD-R, arising out of Vigilance PS Case No. 10 of 2011, subject to the condition that one of the bailers should be close relative of the petitioner and other should be a resident of State of Jharkhand, having sufficient landed property in his/ her name or in the name of his/her ancestors in which he/she is having share and to that effect, he/she has to file an affidavit before the learned trial court indicating his /her share in the property.
7.
The learned Additional Judicial Commissioner-XVIII cum Spl. Judge, CBI, Ranchi may impose any condition to secure appearance of the petitioner.
The petitioner is directed to cooperate with the trial.

(ANANDA SEN, J. ) KNR/
